bio: Graphic designer based in Porto, with a degree in Communication Design from the Faculty of Fine Arts of the University of Porto. My work spans branding, art direction, packaging, label design, signage, UI design and editorial design. I am particularly interested in projects that challenge me creatively and allow me to expand both my graphic and conceptual practice.
